items.text: Bryan Drew is an attorney who has practiced personal injury and civil litigation law for more than 25 years. His campaign says his legal work has included service as a special prosecutor and a victory before the Illinois Supreme Court. He co-owns a cafe. He served eight years as an elected trustee of the Rend Lake Community College Board, including two years as its chair.

items.text: Drew says he would use the office as a watchdog for taxpayers. He wants to improve the comptroller's website so residents can easily track how state money is spent, calling it a top priority. He has also said he would make state spending on non-governmental organizations easier for the public to follow. Drew supports modernizing the comptroller's operations, such as moving away from paper checks, to lower office costs. His campaign pledges to identify fraud and waste.

items.text: Drew has criticized the growth in state spending under the current administration, pointing to a 40% rise without an adjustment for inflation. He has argued that the state needs a fiscal check from outside the party that controls the budget and the governor's office.
